## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to name the agent or signing identity that produced a signature — the WHO of the signing act, complementing the WHICH-KEY of [`gmeow:signingKey`](gmeow-signingKey.md).

### Avoid when

- Avoid for the key that made the signature (that is [`gmeow:signingKey`](gmeow-signingKey.md)) and for the certifier of a key↔identity binding ([`gmeow:certifier`](gmeow-certifier.md)); [`signedBy`](gmeow-signedBy.md) is the claimed signer identity, which a [`gmeow:Certification`](../classes/gmeow-Certification.md) may separately vouch for.

### How to use

- Bind the signing [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md) and pair it with [`gmeow:signingKey`](gmeow-signingKey.md); the identity↔key pair [`signedBy`](gmeow-signedBy.md)/signingKey is exactly what a [`gmeow:Certification`](../classes/gmeow-Certification.md) attests, so a relying party can cross-check the two.

### Examples

- ex:sig1 [`gmeow:signedBy`](gmeow-signedBy.md) ex:lillith.
